verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical shrink-and-center versions. The doodle frame is scaled into the narrow width, which leaves large dead navy bands above the title (~130px) and below the school name (~130px), and the 'National Teacher Appreciation Day' and footer lines are now small and thin for a story format. A spaces the title-to-frame and frame-to-date gaps evenly (~58px each). B sits the frame a little lower, so the footer gap is tighter (~51px) and the date-to-school gap is cramped, which makes it slightly less balanced.
